subject: Recap + next steps: multi-region tech deep-dive & proposed call windows
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@healthlabs.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@medsys.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next steps: multi-region tech deep-dive & proposed call windows

Hi Liam and Priya,

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today — great to hear more about MedSys's ingestion cadence and the latency SLAs you're targeting for the new triage assistant. Quick recap of the important bits from our side: 

- Primary goal: reduce per-query p99 latency to <450ms for the triage route while keeping token cost to under $0.003/query at production volume.
- Workloads: mixed short-chat + long-context summarization (avg 120 tokens, 5% > 1024 tokens).
- Compliance needs: VPC/private deployment for PHI, SOC 2 evidence required for procurement.

Next steps we agreed on:
1) Schedule a technical deep-dive (40–60 mins) with your infra and API owners to validate integration points and confirm network setup.
2) Share discovery notes and a short pilot runbook so you can review internal prerequisites.
3) Run a 3-week pilot with two weekly deep-dive checkpoints (we suggest rotating time windows to accommodate US/EU/APAC stakeholders).

To make scheduling easy across zones, we've proposed a simple rotating cadence we can pilot:
- Week A: Tue 16:00 UTC (friendly to US evening / EU afternoon)
- Week B: Tue 02:00 UTC (APAC-friendly; early APAC / late US)
- Repeat for three pilot weeks so each region gets at least one convenient slot.

Please reply with the names of the people who should join the tech deep-dive and which of the two sample time buckets you prefer. If neither works, share 2–3 windows that fit for your team and we'll adapt. I attached the discovery notes and a short .ics with the proposed windows to make it easy to import.

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (stub), proposed-rotation-windows.ics (stub)

Calendly quick-link: https://calendly.com/redwood/priya-tech-deep-dive

Thanks,

Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

- Pilot cadence: 3 weeks, two touchpoints per week; rotate slots between the two time buckets so APAC/EU/US each get at least one friendly session across the run.

If Ben can confirm reserved capacity for a single host pool on those dates and Marissa can own the runbook share, I'll confirm the 26 May slot with Liam and drop a provisional calendar invite (we'll include an .ics and a Zoom link).
